_about: CELLFEE usage baselines. Policy constants, NOT facts - adjust to your safety standard. Shown in the UI as 'Configured baseline. Adjust to your safety standard.'
label: Configured baseline. Adjust to your safety standard.
note: Decision support from stored test data. Not a safety certification.

reuse.rule: per-application baseline from applications.json (min SoH floor, max C-rate, max temperature, max internal resistance, max cycles in service)

test.label: Restricted use until tested
test.rule: until a full capacity test confirms the grade: low-power, tier-1 duty only, at most 50 cycles

recycle.label: Do not reuse
recycle.rule: no further usage allowed; send to recycling

states.rule: Stop use when health is already below the application floor or the cautious (P10) stop period is 0 cycles; Approaching limit when the cautious stop period is within approaching_margin_cycles; otherwise Safe.

confidence.low_message: Low confidence - run a full test before deploying.

risk.rule: risk = weighted mean of five 0-1 components (see usage.py). Fade-rate and resistance-rise components are percentiles within the 8,753 training snapshots. A battery may only serve applications whose safety tier <= tier_limit[risk level].
